positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected the blueprint for Instagram’s backend modernization, leading the "REST-backed-by-GQL" initiative to migrate mission-critical surfaces (Reels, Stories, Comments) from Python/Django to Hack. Designed the "Cross-Repo Typing" system to enable seamless endpoint migration with zero client-side changes, achieving a ~3x reduction in code volume. Partnered with Core-GQL leadership to define the strategic roadmap for IGWWW, successfully delivering complex legacy migrations and "Shared Types" infrastructure that unblocked major product launches like Visual Comments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New City, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: Architected and delivered high-complexity backend systems for Community Profiles and Group Roles, including a unified permission model that unblocked safety features for the Metaverse. Engineered data pipelines for engagement products at massive scale (5M+ daily volume) while acting as a hybrid TL/PM to ship critical moderation tools during the COVID-19 crisis. Championed engineering excellence, ranking in the top 10% for code quality and privacy compliance while significantly reducing support SLAs.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected and shipped the middleware connecting Google Nest Thermostats to Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant. This integration enabled voice control for over 10 million devices (thermostats and cameras), significantly expanding Nest's ecosystem reach. At the same time I helped staff and expand the offshore Mexico team maintaining a good relationship with the costumer.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, built, and shipped the foundational UI for the Google Cloud Partner Directory (both internal and external sites). This platform enabled Google to efficiently manage business partners and the Cloud products sold through them.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and built the foundational UI for the Project Ara Marketplace, an "AppStore-like" back-office system for the modular Google ARA phone. This platform empowered third-party hardware developers to manage orders and sell their modules

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and shipped the Apache Falcon UI, a project commissioned by Hortonworks and subsequently donated to the Apache Software Foundation. This initiative provided a critical user-friendly alternative to the existing command-line and shell script interfaces.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented a Rules Engine that empowered business stakeholders to define marketing programs via spreadsheets. This innovation eliminated the need for ad-hoc development cycles as well as modernized the UI with Angular JS.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical Leadership: Served as Tech Lead and Client Point of Contact (PoC) for a team of 7 engineers. Traveled extensively between Merida and Chattanooga to gather requirements directly from the client, successfully delivering a Fraud Prevention Platform within a tight 6-month deadline.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a team of 5 developers specializing in complex integrations between legacy Oracle Forms and modern service-based systems. Successfully shipped over 15 projects, facilitating critical system interoperability during the company's acquisition by Medco/Express-scripts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built and shipped a Data Mart model to host operational data from disparate systems. This infrastructure powered the implementation of WebFocus reporting, aimed at supporting leadership with critical decision-making tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Electronic Benefit Vouchers: Designed and shipped the orders module for the launch of the company's electronic benefit vouchers card (now Pluxee). This system allowed employers to efficiently buy and disperse benefit voucher credits to their employees..

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Inventory Management System: Developed a VIN matcher system for Nissan's inventory tracking. This tool allowed users to efficiently locate vehicle units by filtering for specific data criteria encoded directly within the Vehicle Identification Number.
